verdict.rationale: Zep explicitly lists LiveKit as a supported agent framework and documents sub-200ms context retrieval, which is relevant for real-time voice use cases, but there is no mention of Pipecat or ElevenLabs integrations anywhere in the evidence pack, and no dedicated voice-pipeline integration guide beyond the generic framework list. Missing for 10: documented Pipecat and ElevenLabs integrations, a voice-specific quick-start/tutorial, and any hands-on latency validation in an actual voice pipeline.
